description: Puntos de Conectividad Itagüí Inteligente Digital is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Itagüí, Antioquia. Mediante el siguiente conjunto de datos se puede identificar y señalar la ubicación exacta de cada uno de los puntos de conectividad gratuito para la comunidad que componen la iniciativa Itagüí Inteligente Digital. Coverage: Alcaldía de Itagüí, Antioquia. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Itagüí, Antioquia. Its tags are ubicación, zonas wifi, conectividad, itagüí, itagui-gestion-informacion. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2023-09-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
